# House yeast

Rules learned from reviews of Foedrum's own pull requests (ADR 0122), for the files this session reads or changes (ADR 0271). Follow them where your change meets them: /brew-review looks for what they describe.

## spike-notes-state-findings-not-decisions (semantic)

Notes a spike adds to a design page state what was observed and what it implies, never what Foedrum will or will not do: a choice the spike suggests is a decision for an ADR, so the page words it as today's behaviour plus the finding.
